_: The gold set decides which model runs in production (spec §6c).
Positives are the hand-built claims: real quotes, already lint-clean, each
reachable in the first chunk of its document so the model is asked about the
whole passage rather than a fragment of it.
Negatives are the first 20 single-chunk documents, ordered by url_hash, whose
text contains no AI term at all. Ordered rather than chosen, so nobody picked
the easy ones. Text is not prefiltered in production, so these are exactly the
documents a model really is asked about — and [] is the right answer for every
INCOMPLETE. The spec asks for 50 labelled claims and this carries 6. It is a
seed: label the claims the pipeline produces and add them here. Until then the
empty-discipline column is the trustworthy one, and recall is measured over too
